Sunita Rao is a junior DevOps engineer at NexaTech Solutions, where she’s consistently delivered results through data-driven problem-solving and a knack for automation.  

Her CI/CD pipelines, built with ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins, slashed deployment time by 40% for the core product. She owns the Kubernetes cluster managing 5k+ containers, ensuring 99.95% uptime during peak loads. When a critical service degraded, she rapidly triaged the issue, rerouted traffic, and restored stability in 15 minutes.  

She’s a master of operational hygiene—Bash scripts she wrote automate 80% of routine checks, cutting manual work by hours. Her Prometheus/Grafana dashboards cut incident response time by 30%, and she’s proactive about flagging edge cases before they escalate.  

Sunita’s strength lies in her relentless attention to detail and ability to turn complex systems into manageable workflows. She’s a natural collaborator, often mentoring junior devs on best practices. Her work ethic is unshakable—she’ll stay late to debug a flaky service or refactor legacy scripts to align with modern standards. A joy to work with, she’s already lifting the team’s game in measurable ways.
